speaker: rich
transcript:
Cat Eye Eight-One, you need to hear this.

Mike killed a scavenger. Broke his neck.

Minutes later, that same man came through my front door infected.

I put him down again.

He was not bitten.

He died, and then he got back up.

If that happens to everybody, the bombs did not end the outbreak.

They made millions of bodies for it.

I used to believe in God.

A long time ago.

I found my Bible tonight and opened Revelation.

Tell me straight.

Is this what you think we are living through?
summary: Rich asks CatEye81 whether the outbreak follows Revelation.
